export type OAuthPlaceholder = {
    readonly kind: "client_id";
} | {
    readonly kind: "head";
    readonly head: OAuthUrlHead;
} | {
    readonly kind: "context" | "setting";
    readonly key: string;
};

export type OAuthSettingValueFault = "enum" | "pattern" | "path" | "tenant";

export type OAuthUrlHead = "service" | "account" | "tenant" | "gateway";

export declare function isDeclaredOAuth(method: PluginAuthMethodDeclaration): method is PluginOAuthMethodDeclaration;

export declare function oauthCodePointOrder(a: string, b: string): number;

export declare function oauthDeclarableHeader(name: string): boolean;

export declare function oauthFillPlaceholders(template: string, fill: (name: string) => string): string;

export declare function oauthKey(value: unknown): value is string;

export declare function oauthLooksLikePlaceholder(text: string): boolean;

export declare function oauthPathPlaceholders(path: string): {
    readonly name: string;
    readonly placeholder: OAuthPlaceholder | undefined;
}[] | undefined;

export declare function oauthPathSegment(value: string): boolean;

export declare function oauthPlaceholder(name: string): OAuthPlaceholder | undefined;

export declare function oauthPlaceholders(template: string): string[];

export declare function oauthPointerTokens(pointer: string): string[];

export declare function oauthPublicHostName(host: string): boolean;

export declare function oauthSettingValueFault(setting: {
    readonly use: string;
    readonly pattern?: string;
    readonly enum?: readonly string[];
}, value: string, tenantDomain: string | undefined): OAuthSettingValueFault | undefined;

export declare function oauthTenantOriginUnder(domain: string, raw: string): string | undefined;

export declare function oauthUrlTemplate(template: string): {
    readonly head: OAuthUrlHead | undefined;
    readonly name: string;
    readonly path: string;
} | {
    readonly origin: string;
    readonly path: string;
} | undefined;

export declare function oauthValueTemplate(value: string): {
    readonly kind: "literal";
    readonly value: string;
} | {
    readonly kind: "client_id";
} | {
    readonly kind: "context";
    readonly key: string;
} | null;
